import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    sensor_data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(sensor_data['megapixels'], sensor_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Brand Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8)
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(brand_counts))
ax2.barh(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 8 Camera Brands', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(brand_counts.values):
    ax2.text(v + 1, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 3. 4K Video Capability over Years
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
video_by_year = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'has_video_4k': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
video_by_year.columns = ['model_year', '4k_count', 'total_count']
video_by_year['4k_percentage'] = (video_by_year['4k_count'] / video_by_year['total_count']) * 100

ax3.plot(video_by_year['model_year'], video_by_year['4k_percentage'], 
        marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax3.fill_between(video_by_year['model_year'], video_by_year['4k_percentage'], 
                 alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('4K Video Capability (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('4K Video Capability Trend Over Years', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Price Distribution by Body Type
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_types = df['body_type'].value_counts().head(5).index
filtered_df = df[df['body_type'].isin(body_types)]
sns.boxplot(data=filtered_df, y='body_type', x='price_usd', ax=ax4, 
           palette='Set3', orient='h')
ax4.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Weight vs Max ISO colored by price
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['max_iso'], 
                     c=df['price_usd'], cmap='viridis', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=40, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Camera Weight vs Max ISO (colored by Price)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_yscale('log')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Sensor Type Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(sensor_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index,
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 9})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax6.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis Dashboard', 
            fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
